brief: @buildthis.bisks.net custom atproto client (with auth) that presents a single post from their feed with options for “and that’s [good,bad]” when selected records a custom lexicon record, another button reveals after the first selection with an optional “and I think that’s beautiful”
note: one post from your timeline, your call — good or bad, and maybe beautiful. writes a little record to your own repo each time.
